facts.text: The upstream controller class is Keithley2400Controller
identify() returns the reply to the SCPI identity query *IDN?
Measurement mode 2 selects 2-wire sensing with ':SYST:RSEN OFF'; mode 4 selects 4-wire sensing with ':SYST:RSEN ON'
set_nplc writes ':SENS:CURR:NPLC <nplc>' for CURR and ':SENS:VOLT:NPLC <nplc>' for VOLT
iv_sweep enables the source output with ':OUTP ON' and disables it after the reading with ':OUTP OFF'
The README names the device a Keithley 2400 series Source Measure Unit (SMU)
